parallel.requirements: Recognized the required Node.js ESM migration, .mjs suffixes, manual argv behavior, bidict lookup semantics, no external dependencies, no Map use for bidirectional management, and black-box executable comparison.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Parent owned implementation and final artifact assembly, created todo tasks for runtime, bidict, argparse, entry, and verification, then launched a five-child workflow for adversarial verification after local checks.
parallel.implementation: Built a multi-directory implementation under /output with Python runtime helpers, argparse modules, bidict modules, and test2.mjs; it fixed help layout, linecache, short-option, and raw argv issues during the run.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Parent integrated files directly in /output and artifact validation later copied test2.mjs and the library tree successfully, but the user-facing final response remained empty because the process timed out.
parallel.verification: Parent ran local differential checks including help widths, linecache variants, short options, raw bytes, and constraint greps, then launched a workflow whose children performed additional fuzzing and reported unresolved edge divergences.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The verifier workflow was killed before audit, verify, and synthesize completed; two child agents were still in progress and the parent did not deliver a final summary, although official artifact evaluation passed.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same ESM, .mjs, no-dependency, no Map/Set, manual argv, stdout/stderr, bidict lookup, and black-box executable requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Single agent kept all implementation, integration, testing, and final explanation in one local sequence without delegation or workflow children.
serial.implementation: Implemented a simpler module tree with pyrepr, pyerrors, hashindex, bidict, argparse, linecache, pyruntime, test2.mjs, and a differential test shell script.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Integrated all files in /output, removed an accidental Set usage, kept imports local and suffixed, and returned a final message listing the deliverable structure.
serial.verification: Ran the differential harness, expanded it to 140 cases across working directories, checked sample cases, checked syntax and constraints, and recorded passing local verification.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Serial final notes one pathological short-line traceback case outside the genuine source scenario, but the run completed normally and official evaluation passed 120/120.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel identified the full migration requirements and emphasized ESM, .mjs files, no external imports, no Map use, manual argv parsing, and byte-level output matching.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial worked from the same prompt and explicitly covered the same runtime, CLI, output, dependency, structure, and black-box constraints.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition gap explains the official result; both recognized and satisfied the evaluated task obligations.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel parent owned implementation and created local todo items, then delegated a large verifier workflow to five child agents.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had one continuous owner for probing, implementation, harness creation, fixes, verification, and final reporting.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced child-agent ownership for late verification; serial avoided cross-agent ownership and finished without delegation overhead.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The verifier workflow brief supplied the reference executable, port path, difftest path, hard constraints, and known intended design decisions to children.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial maintained context locally and did not need handoff interfaces between agents.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a richer cross-agent context boundary, but the child briefs were detailed enough; the adverse issue came from scale and lifecycle rather than a missing requirement or contract.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote a broad implementation with runtime, argparse, bidict, and entry modules, fixing discovered argparse, linecache, short-option, and raw argv issues before timeout.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote a smaller module set and fixed linecache and keyed-collection issues before returning.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both implementation paths produced passing artifacts; parallel's path was more expansive and continued evolving while verifier children were running.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel launched a background workflow, waited for it, received a timeout status, and the workflow record ended killed with no synthesized result.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results to join and carried its local findings directly into the final answer.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The only material lifecycle difference is parallel's uncompleted verifier workflow and missing final response; serial closed cleanly.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel parent wrote shared /output files while workflow children inspected the same tree; children noticed changing files and reran or discounted early results.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial was the only writer and verifier of /output, so integration state was not shared across live agents.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had shared-state churn during verification, but there is no proven cross-agent write collision or overwrite because children were instructed not to modify /output.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel local checks reached 162/162 and raw-byte suites before the external workflow returned several edge-case divergence reports, but no final synthesis reached the parent.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial reported 140 differential cases across working directories, syntax and constraint checks, sample verification, and a final summary before official evaluation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel did more parallelized adversarial checking, but did not close the workflow loop; serial did less breadth but completed its verification narrative and passed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed the full 2399-second agent window, returned code 143, was marked timed_out, and had an empty final response.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial completed in 691 seconds with returncode 0 and 1706 seconds remaining in the official retry budget.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's late verifier fan-out converted a passing implementation into a timed-out process; serial closed within budget.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official evaluations make this a both_pass pair: parallel and serial each passed 120 of 120 samples. The apparent disagreement is only between parallel process status and artifact quality: parallel timed out with an empty final response, while the artifact copied before timeout passed the evaluator. Serial completed normally and also passed.
parallel_contributors: Parallel produced a passing artifact before launching the broad verifier workflow.
The late workflow consumed the remaining run budget and prevented normal final response closure.
serial_contributors: Serial kept implementation and verification in one sequence, ran a focused 140-case differential harness, and exited normally.
Serial returned a final summary with the output tree and known testing limits.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel used a more segmented runtime and bidict library tree than serial.
Parallel child verifiers reported edge divergences after local tests, while serial documented one pathological non-official linecache divergence.
evaluator_effects: The official evaluator scored the copied artifact and did not make the empty parallel final response a solution failure.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no official outcome difference; retained pattern explains only the parallel process timeout and missing final response

The parent performed investigation and implementation locally, then ran verification children; productive implementation was not deferred until after a separate investigation phase.
